notes: ASP.NET WebForms. Refinance and lending rate tables only — no deposit rate tables

gap_classification.notes: NABARD is an apex development financial institution (refinances co-operative banks, RRBs and rural development schemes). Its site (nabard.org) is reachable but publishes no retail/public fixed-deposit product or rate card; it does not accept term deposits from the general public. The site's 'Interest Rate' link refers to refinance/lending rates, not retail FD.
